purpose: read-only freeze list that MUST be written before any 2022 evaluation (task §9.1)

frozen_candidates.reason: no V2 candidate passed the retention rule: C2/C3, F1/F2/F3, TabM dropout0.2 / correlation loss and TCN W20 all failed the DEV gate or reversed under three seeds
frozen_candidates.fallback: V1_FIXED_ANCHOR = 0.5 x C1 (3 seeds) + 0.5 x TabM (3 seeds), frozen graph

c1.recipe: depth8/l2=15, RMSE, lr0.03, 3000-cap, 25-tree inner IC selection, near-opt 0.0005 earliest, fold-local weights, 6 threads

tabm.recipe: k8/width128/2 blocks/dropout0.1, AdamW lr1e-3 wd1e-3, clip1, batch 8 days, 100 epoch/patience12, inner IC epoch selection, outer refit from scratch

control.features: F0 (33-1 banned) + G1 (19) = 61 columns, order as src/qf3/constants.py
control.fusion_graph: atom rank -> seed mean -> family weight (0.5/0.5) -> final rank

evaluation_boundaries.evaluation_days: 2022 legal signal days from the independent panel calendar
evaluation_boundaries.label_boundary: models trained with label_end_date <= 20211231; no 2022 label used for fitting

block_bootstrap.scheme: fixed-length paired moving block, per year, day count preserved

decision_rule.support: main candidate 2022 dIC > 0 and both halves >= -0.001
decision_rule.no_recall: no re-weighting, feature, seed or algorithm change after opening 2022
